findings.text: follow-on: source_triangle duplicates the centre-cell Delaunay lookup and barycentric weighting owned by nova/equilibrium/contour_tree_mesh.py:152 (_barycentric_flux) and its caller at line 258, so the wall-interpolation diagnostic forks a geometry the repository already owns rather than reusing or wrapping the owner.

follow-on: the negative_control reason (decided by the smooth-field gradient, not by a check it writes) misstates the probe, which does gate its verdict with self-written assertions at probe.py:163-173 and the analytic-axis positive control at probe.py:234, so the none declaration understates the run's own control.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against 4a266ca5b; 7e86daca8 adds only probe.py (428 lines) and ae5b1c123 adds the figure SVG (2030 lines) and the 45-line evidence fragment, and no nova/ source is edited.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is that docs/figures/contour-tree-topology-authority/sol-wall-pair/sol-wall-pair.svg is committed and its rendered PNG is inspected with no clipped or overlapping label; the SVG is in commit ae5b1c123, the manifest records the render and inspection, and re-rendering the committed SVG to a 1400 px PNG shows legible, separate, unclipped labels in both panels.
item_verdicts.goal: read the source goal (a probe script and figure measuring the smooth-field gradient and the carrier-minus-smooth flux around carrier vertices 10 and 447 on diverted-single-null-340-cells); scripts/prototypes/contour_tree_sol_wall_pair/probe.py:154 focus_measure returns |grad psi| at vertex 10 (31.252 mWb/m), the two-pitch window minimum (12.497 mWb/m) against a 14.672 mWb/m SOL median, and carrier-minus-smooth for all five link vertices at probe.py:199, so the goal is met.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, tests naming the probe command run at ae5b1c123, test_logs probe-committed.log with a bare EXIT=0 last line, negative_control none with a stated reason, and the twelve census rows and one focus row under evidence_inputs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest orientation_write_paths declare scripts/prototypes/contour_tree_sol_wall_pair, docs/figures/contour-tree-topology-authority/sol-wall-pair and docs/evidence/fragments/contour-tree-topology-authority/sol-wall-pair-probe.html; the diff touches only those three paths, all inside the fence.

justifications.durability: probe.py:170 raises if vertex 10 is no longer the carrier minimum and probe.py:172 pins it to an independent published receipt value, and probe.py:234 requires the analytic axis positive control, so a regression that moves the pair reddens the probe, but the guards live in a manually run prototype rather than a test a suite executes.
justifications.evidence: every figure and manifest number reconciles with probe-committed.log (31.252 mWb/m at vertex 10, window 12.497 versus SOL 14.672 mWb/m, +400.509 and +954.529 uWb), though the done_when's own measure rests on a recorded visual inspection rather than a mechanical label check.
justifications.fit: probe.py:22 calls configure_dtypes before any array and probe.py:25-30 defer the post-configure imports behind noqa E402, following the nova dtype idiom, and every added symbol is descriptive with no plan, version or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: probe.py:154 measures the smooth gradient and probe.py:199 the carrier-minus-smooth flux at vertex 10 and its link, exactly the quantities the goal names, though the figure and check are confined to one fixture.
justifications.reuse: probe.py:95 source_triangle re-derives the centre-cell Delaunay simplex lookup plus barycentric weighting that nova/equilibrium/contour_tree_mesh.py already owns at line 152 (_barycentric_flux), extending no owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 4a266ca5b..ae5b1c123 touches only the three files inside the manifest's declared write paths and edits no nova/ source.
